fullTextEN: Hello!

fullTextEN: Among all these jobs, the one I liked the most

Maybe at 4:30 I had to get up,
then take the train to work,
At that time, it was still dark,
The sky was still dark,
Dark. Yes,

fullTextZH: 可是我不觉得那个工作很苦，

Although I really like sleeping,

fullTextZH: 可是我还是很喜欢那个工作。

If you are a barista,

fullTextEN: then you can drink a lot of free coffee every day.

you are just making your coffee,

want to make the latte art look better,
so for me,

fullTextEN: making coffee is a very, very therapeutic job,
I really enjoy making coffee.

fullTextEN: then you might like my job even more.

my manager is very nice to me,

So every time we laughed loudly,

fullTextEN: only the laughter of my colleague and me.
Yes, because every time we laughed loudly,
We laughed very loudly,

fullTextEN: but I think our manager was not angry.

fullTextZH: 所以我们继续聊天我们继续大笑，

This made me feel

it really doesn't feel like working,
it's like playing with friends.
Then working at this hotel
you can drink free coffee,

lunch and dinner are both available.
Hmm~ this, this,

beans, and then there are eggs.
Yes,
you can't finish all these things,

So for me,

it was a very happy time.
